observations: Standing cooker with three gas burners and one electric hotplate.
Five control knobs on the front panel.
Oven door is open, showing one internal wire rack.
Glass top lid is present and appears intact.
Stainless steel or silver-colored exterior finish.
The bottom front panel has peeling protective film or minor surface irregularities.
No brand name or model number is visible on the front or top of the appliance.
Watermark 'HITHE TECHNOLOGIES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on all photos.

claims.evidence: The item looks clean, but 'refurbished' status cannot be confirmed visually.
Requires a video of burners, hotplate, and oven in operation.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: Contradicts the 'refurbished' claim; a one-year-old barely used item typically does not require refurbishing.
These documents are not shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Gas burners or oven may have leaks or faulty ignition.
risks.proof: Video showing all gas burners and the oven burner being lit and maintaining a steady flame.

risks.risk: The electric hotplate may be burnt out.
risks.proof: Video showing the hotplate heating up.

risks.risk: The internal motor (rotisserie or fan) may be seized or noisy.
risks.proof: Video with sound showing the motor/rotisserie in operation.

risks.risk: The item may be a generic or lower-tier brand disguised as a premium one.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate, usually found on the back or inside the door frame.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's label/plate showing the brand and model number.
Video of all three gas burners and the oven burner lit at the same time.
Video showing the electric hotplate heating up.
Photos of the mentioned receipt and warranty card.
response.reason: The brand and model are essential for pricing this appliance and are currently missing. Furthermore, the seller's claims are contradictory, as a 'barely used' item from 'last year' should not require being 'refurbished'.
